[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have really bad dark circles under my eyes, and trying to conceal them is hard because the discoloration always seems to show through. I want to actually do something about them rather than just trying to hide them, so I was really excited to try this serum considering I love the Cerave brand and it contains Vitamin C. It's a very lightweight formula that absorbs into the skin quickly, it isn't greasy or sticky, and it instantly makes the under eye area look and feel hydrated. I'm seeing a bit of lightening of my dark circles but I want to keep using it until it's gone to see the full results. I do recommend this though!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Cevera Vitamin C Eye Cream is light and feels comfortable-no olly, sticky, or heavy residue. Overall, it's a gentle and portable eye cream, but the results for brightening or de-puffing are minimal for me.

avis.titre: Made my skin soft, but not much brighter.

I have dark circles in my eye area and have been looking for an eye cream to help brighten them up a bit. The texture was nice and thick enough to feel the moisture. But light enough that my skin absorbed it nicely. Unfortunately, my eye area is still on the darker side with a tiny bit of progress. If nothing else, I can say that my dark circles are very soft. Maybe this is going in the right direction. I probably just need more time and to stay consistent.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the CeraVe Skin Renewing Vitamin C Eye Cream for a few weeks now, and I've started to notice some results. After consistent use, I've noticed a reduction in puffiness and dark circles, and this eye cream has brightened my uber eye area. I have not noticed a reduction in fine lines, but maybe with longer use, I will. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, heavy, or sticky. Lastly, the creamy consistency felt soothing when applied. My under-eye area felt more hydrated and looked brighter almost immediately.

avis.titre: I will definitely continue using this product.

I use it faithfully. My eyes are still dark, but I see a difference. Having dark eyes my whole life, I didn't expect a change overnight. I'm going to continue using this product twice daily!

If you're looking for something extra special to change your under eye area, this won't do it for you.
